name: Thomas Werdmüller — a son David by Regula Steiner (bapt. 1698, Zürich)
researcher_question: Did Thomas Werdmüller of Zürich (b. 1657) have a son David baptised 27 March 1698 by a Regula Steiner, while married to Dorothea von Muralt?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-2.csv row 28, hint-samples.csv row 870, flag adds_spouse, confidence 3). RESOLVED: false match. The 27 Mar 1698 Zürich baptism belongs to a different Thomas Werdmüller, the one married to Regula Steiner, whose nine children were baptised in the same parish 1692-1712 — the last two after the subject's 1704 death. Disproving record ark:/61903/1:1:66JR-7TSH (21 Apr 1712). The subject's wife Dorothea von Muralt was buried 16 Jan 1735 (ark:/61903/1:1:66JB-RGNM), ruling out a successor marriage. Resolved on index evidence: the register image 403'd and was not read.
